summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting MSD Investment Corp.'s entry into a Third Supplemental Indenture for a $300 million private placement of 6.375% notes due 2029. The notes are unsecured obligations, maturing June 12, 2029, with interest payable semi-annually. Proceeds will repay outstanding debt and for general corporate purposes. There is no special-situation event; this is a routine debt issuance. The filing is categorized as 'None'.
